title: Cosmic No Entry Orb
description: A large transparent crystal ball resting on an ornate metallic stand contains a surreal glowing scene. Inside, a winding yellow path leads toward a tall dark tower topped with a glowing red orb, flanked by a red octagonal 'NO ENTRY' sign, with rows of empty theater seats on both sides under a massive ornate circular structure emitting purple energy beams and lightning.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal scene contained within a large transparent crystal ball on a metallic stand. Inside the orb, a glowing yellow winding path leads to a tall dark tower with a bright red orb on top. A red octagonal NO ENTRY sign stands in the foreground. Rows of empty blue theater seats flank both sides of the path. Above everything is an ornate circular golden structure emitting intense purple and blue energy beams and lightning. Dramatic cinematic lighting, vibrant neon colors against dark background.
